questions.stem: A regular hexagon is drawn inside a circle of radius 5 cm, with all six vertices on the circle.

parts.label: a
parts.prompt: Find the angle at the centre of the circle between the radii to two neighbouring vertices.

parts.label: b
parts.prompt: Write down the length of one side of the hexagon. Give a reason for your answer.
parts.answer: 5 cm, because the hexagon splits into six equilateral triangles

parts.label: c
parts.prompt: Describe how to construct the perpendicular bisector of a line segment $AB$ using only a ruler and compasses.
parts.answer: Arcs of equal radius (more than half of $AB$) from $A$ and $B$, meeting above and below $AB$; join the two crossing points
partial: B1 for equal arcs from both ends
